class.name: PortalAStar3D
class.brief_description: Native portal-aware A* costs for traversal graphs.
class.description: Retains [AStar3D]'s directed connections, search, point weights and disabled-point behavior. Configured portal edges use a fixed cost instead of their Euclidean length; the heuristic includes those shortcuts as an admissible lower bound for graphs whose ordinary connections use Euclidean costs and weight scales of at least 1. Native costs bypass script cost overrides while [member native_costs_enabled] is enabled. Disable it to compare an existing script implementation. Point additions, moves, removals and clearing invalidate native cost caches. Changing disabled points does not invalidate the geometric lower bound; shortcuts through disabled points can only make that bound more conservative. Like [AStar3D], an instance must not be queried concurrently from multiple threads.

method.name: configure_portal_connections
method.description: Sets directed portal pairs as [code][from_id, to_id, from_id, to_id, ...][/code]. Endpoints must exist. The cost must be finite and nonnegative. Up to 128 unique portal endpoints are supported; invalid input leaves the previous configuration intact. An empty array restores ordinary Euclidean native costs. This does not connect points; use [method AStar3D.connect_points] to establish graph edges.

members.member: Whether to use native portal costs instead of script cost overrides.
